tasks.name: Remote Codex binding by remote mtime (R10)
tasks.description: _activate_pm_remote gains not_before. With it, a remote ironclaude-session-<pid>.id is accepted only when its remote mtime, from the new _remote_id_file_mtime helper, is >= not_before. The helper calls _ssh_manager.run_argv(host, ['sh','-c', script, 'sh', pid]); the script builds the path from $HOME, because run_argv quotes arguments so ~ would not expand (ssh_manager.py:112-128), and runs 'stat -c %Y' (GNU/busybox) || 'stat -f %m' (BSD/macOS).
